Bob runs at 6 miles per hour. In one hour he will cover 6 miles. Jim runs at 9 miles per hour and he has 1 mile head start. They will cover the 1 mile head start in 1/6 hour. The time they will take to meet each other depends on their speeds.
Since Jim is faster he will cover a distance of 9 miles in 1/9 hour. After 1/9 hour he would have covered 1/9 * 9 = 1 mile.
Thus they will meet each other after 1/6 + 1/9 = 3/6 = 1/2 hours.
Since there are 60 minutes in an hour, 1/2 hours is equal to 60 * 1/2 = 30 minutes.
The answer is 30.
</think>
<answer>30</answer>

Since Bob has a 1 mile head start, this means that Bob will run an additional 1 mile while Jim runs past this 1 mile head start.

Peter’s 80 white stamps will be sold for 80 x 20 cents = 1600 cents.
In total, they will be able to sell 1500 cents - 1600 cents = 100 cents between them.
In dollars, they will make 100 cents x 0.01 = $1.
The difference in the amount of money they make is 1 dollar - 0 dollar = $1.
</think>
<answer>1</answer>
